race.description: Sheridan Garage Doors Country Boosted Hcp (C3)
race.comment: FEEDBACK (7) is the horse to beat after returning to this track and winning a CG BM58 by a head, with KARUTA KING behind him and NATIONAL ASSET also held safely enough. His prior Canberra run is easy to excuse after racing wide without cover. Can repeat the dose. NAGADEC (2) brings a last-start BM58 win at Moruya and had charged home for fourth at this venue the run before. Here off a freshen and should get her chance from an inside barrier. NATIONAL ASSET (3) was only just over a length from FEEDBACK last start after beginning slowly and had earlier been competitive in a BM66 at Goulburn, which keeps him right in the argument. BATTLE ABBEY (10) lacks the same winning edge, but his latest fourth behind FEEDBACK was sound and his wet-track record gives him a genuine place-to-win upset profile if he takes another step fourth-up.
